142858.overview:
Glimmerati is a story-driven arcade racing game with N-Gage exclusive features. The game has a branching storyline setup in the lifestyle of luxury cars, fast boats, amazing parties and stunning supermodels. The player lives the high life in real world based locations around Europe as he races against the cream of society to climb the ladder in Club Glimmerati.

The branching story mode has a variety of different mission types from races to music video shoots. The whole story is voice acted in english. The game includes a Club Card feature, in which are recorded the best lap times, highest scores, rewards and diary entries from the story. Club Cards can be uploaded and downloaded for player comparison from the global ranking server, N-Gage Arena.

Glimmerati also features a quick race game mode, a time trial game mode with a global ranking list and up to four player bluetooth game mode.
